title: Gen AI Software Engineer Senior
description: Company DescriptionExperian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.Job DescriptionWe are looking for an Automation Engineer with experience with automation and modern AI/GenAI/Agentic technologies. You will use your programming knowledge of AI/GenAI/Agentic to build automation workflows for our business processes. You will integrate large language models (LLMs) and agentic automation solutions into our processes, helping the team improve operations and improve efficiency. This is a fantastic opportunity to engage with educational credentials and explore personal and professional projects in AI and automation. You will report to the Smart Automation Delivery Manager.Build Automation Workflows: Develop scripts and tools to improve processes like onboarding, transactions, and reporting.Integrate AI and LLMs: Enhance workflows using generative AI (e.g., OpenAI APIs) for tasks like document handling and decision support.Agentic AI Solutions: Design agent-based automations using frameworks like CrewAI to perform multi-step tasks independently.Data Retrieval & RAG: Use vector databases and RAG techniques to allow context-aware AI outputs from stored knowledge.Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with product, operations, and data teams to translate our needs into automation solutions.Maintain: Test, document, and increase workflows; stay current with AI trends and support deployed solutions.QualificationsQualificationsEducation & Experience: Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field, with 5+ years of overall experience and 1–2 years in GenAI/Agentic AI technologies.Programming Skills: Python proficiency with clean, efficient coding; experience in TypeScript or JavaScript.Generative & Agentic AI: Hands-on experience with LLMs, OpenAI API (or similar), prompt engineering, and frameworks like CrewAI.Vector Databases and RAG: Understanding of vector databases (e.g., FAISS, LlamaIndex) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation techniques.API & Cloud Integration: Experienced in RESTful APIs, JSON/XML handling, and deploying automation workflows using AWS, Azure, or GCP.Problem Solving & Communication: Experience building scalable, resilient, and observable distributed systems and experience creating detailed technical documentation and concepts across teams.Additional InformationOur uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.Benefits/Perks:Our benefits include: Medical, life and dental insurance, Asociacion Solidarista, International Share Save Plan, Flex Work/Work from home, Paid time off, Annual Performance Bonus, Education Reimbursement, Family Bonding, Bereavement Leave, Referral Program, and more.This is a fully remote job opportunity. title: Senior Lead - AI Engineer - LLM's and Agents
description: DescriptionSenior Lead - AI EngineerDescriptionDo you want to work to make Power for Good?We’re the world’s largest independent renewable energy company, guided by a simple yet powerful vision to create a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero carbon energy.We know that achieving our ambitions would be impossible without our people. Because we’re tackling some of the world’s toughest problems, we need the very best people to help us. They’re our most important asset so that’s why we continually invest in them.RES is a family with a diverse workforce, and we are dedicated to the personal and professional growth of our people, no matter what stage of their careers they’re at. We can promise you rewarding work which makes a real impact, the chance to learn from inspiring colleagues from across a growing, global network and opportunities to grow personally and professionally.Our competitive package offers a wide range of benefits and rewards.Locations: UK - Kings Langley or Glasgow. Spain - Albacete or Madrid.Summary / Purpose Of The RoleAre you ready to engineer the future of AI at one of the world’s leading renewable energy businesses? At RES, we are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build and run the LLM and agent services on our global data and AI platform.This is a hands-on role: you will spend at least 70% of your time building. You will create LLM and RAG services, agents and multi-agent workflows that work over RES’s finance, construction, project, development and HR data. You will also set the AI engineering standards and patterns the rest of the team uses.Reporting to the Head of Data and AI Analytics, you will work closely with our data engineers, modellers and analysts on how AI uses enterprise data. Our Platform Operations team handles day-to-day platform running and infrastructure, so you can focus on building AI.Example use casesAgents that answer questions over finance, construction and project data in Microsoft FabricDocument AI for contracts, project documents and reportsAI assistants built into Power BI reporting and business workflowsKey AccountabilitiesBuild AI services: Design, code and deploy LLM and RAG services, agents and multi-agent workflows, from prototype to production. Evaluation and testing: Set up automated evaluation, testing for non-deterministic outputs, and quality gates before release. AI architecture and patterns: Define reference designs and reusable patterns for generative AI, agents and retrieval, aligned with our data platform standards. Data for AI: Work with our modellers and engineers so enterprise data is structured for AI agents to search, retrieve and reason over reliably. Engineering standards: Set coding standards for Python and LLM orchestration, review code, and build reusable code repositories for the team. Cost efficiency: Design for efficient token use, semantic caching and compute cost control. Security by design: Work with Cyber Security and the Data and AI Governance Lead to build access controls (RBAC), data privacy and prompt-injection defences into all agents. New technology: Evaluate and prototype emerging AI technologies, such as MCP servers, vector databases, knowledge graphs, small and open models, and multimodal AI, and bring proven ones into use. Coaching and advice: Coach team members and graduates on AI engineering, and advise stakeholders on AI options and trade-offs. Experience RequiredLLM and AI engineering: Hands-on experience building LLM solutions in Python, including RAG and agent frameworks (for example LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or AutoGen). Experience taking AI into production is an advantage. Software engineering: Clean, modular, tested code in Python and SQL; building and consuming REST APIs; version control and CI/CD. AI cloud services: Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search, or equivalent services on another enterprise cloud. LLM evaluation and operations: Testing, monitoring and improving LLM quality, latency and cost. AI security: Understanding of security for LLM and agent systems, including prompt injection, data access and guardrails. Engineering judgement: Understanding of the limits of generative AI, and good judgement on when to use AI and when to use deterministic code or rules. Communication: Able to explain technical options clearly, run workshops and work with business stakeholders. Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. DesirableMachine learning and MLOps: model deployment, monitoring and retrainingMicrosoft Fabric, Power BI or DatabricksKnowledge graphs or semantic modelsResponsible AI frameworks (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act)Why RES?A global remit: Build AI used across a worldwide renewable energy business. Real impact: The agents you build will support business decisions across renewable energy projects worldwide. A modern, cloud-first stack: Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Purview, MCP servers and significant innovation investment. A collaborative, growing team: Join an experienced data and AI function with scope to shape how AI develops at RES. Agentic AI: Set the blueprint for how RES builds and runs AI agents. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Lead Data Scientist - Agentic AI / AML
description: Company DescriptionWise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.For everyone, everywhere.Job DescriptionMore about our mission and what we offer.Lead Data Scientist - Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Handling & PreventWe’re looking for a Lead Data Scientist (IC3) to join our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Handling & Prevent team in London.This role is a unique opportunity to work on the AI and intelligence systems at the core of our operational handling and prevention work. You'll help build and automate components of our operational systems using Generative AI, LLMs and agentic AI approaches, establish robust LLM evaluation pipelines, and build solutions that reduce financial crime risk. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.The AML Handling & Prevent team offers an exciting environment for applying cutting-edge Generative AI, Agentic AI and machine learning architectures. This team is dedicated to enhancing our financial crime mitigation operations through advanced tooling, automated evaluation frameworks, prompt optimisation and increasingly autonomous AI workflows, aiming to streamline reviews and simplify the work of our operations staff. As a Lead Data Scientist (IC3), you will drive technical strategy across handling and prevent initiatives, architect robust AI systems, establish post-deployment monitoring, and lead complex automation initiatives to reduce financial crime risk across Wise.Here’s How You’ll Be ContributingEnd-to-End AI Automation & EDD LLMs: Lead the development and deployment of AI models designed to augment operational workflows (e.g. Business and Consumer EDD LLMs), specifically targeting the automation of case summaries, red flag generation, risk classifications, document requests and agentic workflows.Evaluation Framework & Labeling Taxonomy: Establish labeling taxonomies and guidelines with EDD SMEs, construct evaluation datasets, and implement automated eval harnesses to systematically measure accuracy, precision, recall, and failure modes.Prompt Optimization & Experimentation: Audit existing prompts and run structured experiments (few-shot, chain-of-thought, context ordering) within a hypothesis-driven testing framework to reduce hallucinations, formatting errors, and prompt drift.Agentic AI Systems: Help design and develop AI workflows that can reason across multiple steps, use tools and contextual information, and support complex operational processes safely and reliably.Shadow Testing & Monitoring: Design shadow mode deployments and parallel execution testing to safely evaluate prompts and AI workflows at scale, while implementing post-deployment monitoring for data and output drift.Full-Stack Deployment: Take ownership of the production pipeline by writing and deploying production-ready Python services. You must be willing to bypass engineering bottlenecks to ship value quickly while maintaining code quality.Human-in-the-Loop Architecture: Design systems where AI provides recommendations and drafts, ensuring human operators retain the final decision-making authority for critical financial crime mitigation assessments.Strategic Demand Deflection: Go beyond ticket handling by analyzing upstream data to create strategies that deflect financial crime attempts before they reach the operations team, effectively reducing manual workload.Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Set technical direction, mentor Senior and Junior Data Scientists, foster a product-focused mindset, and guide the team through complex technical implementations, architectural decisions, and AI governance standards.A Bit About YouExperience implementing, training, testing and evaluating performance of Machine Learning systems;Strong Python knowledge. A big plus for proven familiarity and experience with OOP principles;Some hands-on experience developing or working with GenAI / LLM solutions. You don’t need to be an LLM specialist, but you should have professional exposure to areas such as prompt engineering, evaluation, LLM-powered workflows or Agentic AI;Knowledge and experience developing and evaluating GenAI / LLM solutions, including automated eval harnesses and prompt engineering;Experience with statistical analysis, experiment design, and failure mode analysis in ML or LLM systems;A strong product mindset with the ability to work independently in a cross-functional and cross-team environment;Good communication skills and ability to get the point across to non-technical individuals and SMEs;Strong problem solving skills with the ability to help refine problem statements and figure out how to solve them.Some Extra Skills That Are Great (but Not Essential)Familiarity with automating operational processes via technical solutions, for example Large Language Models, AI agents or multi-step AI workflowsExperience implementing fine-tuning, reinforced learning alignment and evaluation techniques within an LLM training pipeline.Familiarity with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph or similar.Experience designing tool-using agents, orchestration workflows or human-in-the-loop AI systems.Willingness to get hands dirty reading many, many historical operational cases.Working knowledge of Java.We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in.Also, qualifications aren’t that important to us. If you’ve got great experience, and you’re great at articulating your thinking, we’d like to hear from you.And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.Additional InformationOffice: LondonKey BenefitsStock options in a profitable companyHybrid working model - whether it’s working from home, working overseas, school plays or life admin we get that flexibility is essential Annual personal development budget - whether it’s for books, courses, or conferencesVisa and relocation support You can read more about our full benefits package here...For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
